security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI caches device measurement transcript data from a previous sbi_covg_get_device_measurements call and returns stale cached data on a subsequent call, instead of re-fetching the latest measurement from the TSM or device. Since the spec now explicitly allows multiple calls to obtain updated measurements, cached data violates the freshness guarantee.
security_spec.summary: sbi_covg_get_device_measurements permits repeated calls for latest device measurements; OpenSBI must re-fetch (not cache) measurement transcripts to prevent stale attestation data from being served to TVMs

findings.finding: COVG device measurement (sbi_covg) is not implemented in this OpenSBI codebase — no measurement cache code exists to violate the freshness guarantee. No stale cached data can be returned because the SBI extension is entirely absent.
